description: This file defines functions to generate skeleton/loading placeholder HTML for UI components related to event metadata, date pickers, and booking slots, with layout variations based on device type and page context.

methods.name: generateEventMetaSkeleton
methods.description: Generates HTML skeleton for event metadata section with animated placeholders.

methods.name: generateDatePickerSkeleton
methods.description: Creates HTML skeleton for date picker component, including month navigation and day grid placeholders.

methods.name: generateBookingSlotsPageSkeleton
methods.description: Produces layout-specific skeleton for booking slots page, adapting to mobile or desktop layouts.

methods.name: generateSkeleton
methods.description: Main exported function that returns appropriate skeleton based on page type and layout.
